ui_environment: Real xen-native with dev host 192.168.8.170, isolated Xvfb :98, existing tools/audit_native_clicks_live.py used interactively without adding an audit tool
happy_path: Native Take Snapshot click produced a successful task and a snapshot confirmed by XenAPI snapshot_of. Native Start on the diskless PV test VM was observed In progress, then Failed / INTERNAL_ERROR; Failed filter isolated it. Status-bar progress was clicked while Events was already selected; navigation from a different page was not proven.
alert_dismissal: Native Actions > Dismiss removed message zz-parity-S5; message.get_all_records confirmed absence.
csv: Native Export saved a UTF-8 CSV, parsed as 540 records and five upstream columns; multiline quote escaping covered by a unit test.
menus: Full VM context menu fit on screen; consistent font, 22 logical px items and 7 px separators. Halted Start remained visible when disabled. Labels tested against split single-letter words.
rejection: Final binary: Go To was disabled for an alert whose object no longer exists; clicking it left Alerts selected.
retained_command: Check again remains under Events row Actions for unreachable tasks.
cleanup: Test VM, its snapshot, explicit alert and generated snapshot message removed; XenAPI readback confirms absence and host answers. Snapshot received the default UI name because XTest text entry lost characters; its recorded UUID and snapshot_of were checked, then it was renamed zz-parity-S5-snapshot before removal.
limitations: Events screenshots precede the final table width adjustment, six-column row-selection layout and per-host filter choices. Final Alerts screenshot is from the final build.
Running state was captured for the failed Start; the snapshot completed before the Events screenshot.
Live cancellation, bulk dismissal, Help/Go To success, date/server filtering, and the 1000-entry cap were not exercised.
The created test VM required VM.update_allowed_operations to refresh stale allowed_operations inherited from its source template.
Local operation dates and host message/task dates differed by approximately seven hours; timestamp handling was left unchanged.
Status-bar navigation from a different page was not verified. The snapshot was observed completed, while running progress was observed on the failed Start.
git: No commit, push, tag or GitHub issue changes. Unrelated untracked M2a-properties-dialog.md left untouched.
status: PARTIAL: implementation complete; required same-task running-to-completed observation and final Events UI revision were not fully qualified within the verification budget.
